method: Hand-read from primary HTML documents on SEC EDGAR. No XBRL APIs, no R*.htm renderings, no FilingSummary.xml, no third-party sources.

filings.amendments: No 10-K/A exists for this period in the EDGAR submissions index (checked all forms beginning with 10-K for CIK 1637459).

filings.notes: Filed late (June 2019) because of the restatement. FY2017 and FY2016 comparative columns in the Consolidated Statements of Income are jointly headed 'As Restated & Recast' (the spanning header covers only the 2017 and 2016 columns, not 2018). Cash-flow-statement comparatives are headed 'As Restated'.

values.note: The largest write-off in this fixture set and the case the measure exists for. It sits as its own caption on the face of the income statement, between 'Selling, general and administrative expenses, excluding impairment losses' and 'Intangible asset impairment losses' — so goodwill is separable from other intangibles here, which it is not in the Target filing.

values.note: An em-dash in the printed statement, which is this filer's nil. Recorded because a five-year window over this company runs across both a stated nil and the largest charge in the set, and the measure has to read them as 0 and 7,008 rather than as absent and 7,008.

values.stated_scale: in millions, except per share data
values.caption: Intangible asset impairment losses
values.column: December 29, 2018 — current-year column (the 'As Restated & Recast' spanning header covers only the 2017 and 2016 columns)
values.note: NOT what goodwill_impairment resolves to, and recorded so that a wrong resolution is detectable rather than plausible. Kraft Heinz wrote off 7,008 of goodwill and 8,928 of other intangibles in the same year, on adjacent lines of the same statement. Any mapping that reached for the larger or the combined figure would produce a number that looks entirely reasonable.
